Edward F. Gallagher III publicly known as Chef Eddie G, (born March 9, 1966) is an American celebrity chef, restaurateur, author, culinary consultant and TV personality.
Early life and education
Gallagher was born in Manhattan, New York, to Irish and German parents. He grew up in a diverse neighborhood with a rich cultural tapestry, which fostered his early interest in food. He gained initial culinary experience working in a small Italian restaurant during high school. He further refined his culinary expertise at Johnson & Wales University, graduating with degrees in culinary arts, business management, and resort management.
Career
Gallagher's career has influenced by his international travel, having visited over 40 countries and worked in over 100 kitchens worldwide. He has owned and operated several restaurants and co-founded Locavore Ventures, a company focused on farm-to-table cuisine. He is the host of Chef Eddie G. Locavore, a Amazon Prime Video show that explores local food systems and sustainable cooking practices.
Gallagher is also a published author with two cookbooks: Cooking Coast2Coast Cuisine and Cooking Local With Chef Eddie G. He has made television appearances on various networks, including Food Network, NBC, and Disney. He has served as a culinary ambassador at 400 Super Bowls and Rose Bowls.
